fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (11840 Standing Stone Dr / 41.1544,-96.0430) landed in downtown Papillion — wrong. Hormel's own page and CRE reporting confirm Papillion Foods is the former Shopko distribution center at 10808 S 132nd St, Papillion NE 68138 (built 2000, +2004 addition, 535,000 sq ft, 80-acre site, converted by Hormel and opened 2020 for Columbus dry sausage/salami). Resolved to the large converted DC at ~41.1518,-96.1245 in the Sarpy West industrial submarket: footprint and ~86-acre parcel match the 535k sq ft / 80-acre figures, the roof shows a two-phase (2000/2004) addition seam, large ammonia-refrigeration condenser arrays and rooftop solar, a south-facing dock bank with trailers, employee parking, and a formal flagpole-circle entrance. Confidence medium because the corridor has several large warehouses and recent on-site Street View was unavailable to read current signage.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point seen in satellite imagery; truck access road runs openly from the public road into the dock yard. A small utility building sits in a landscaped grass island near the access road but is NOT a guard booth (not astride the lane). Flagged uncertain — only older (2007-2010) interior Street View was available.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth straddling the truck lane visible. Uncertain due to imagery age.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck yard inside the property between the access road and the dock face provides ample queue/holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the public road through the yard to the dock face — easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large open paved truck yard with unused width — abundant room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South building face carries a long dock bank; estimated ~40 doors (25-50 band) from z17-z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked across the south/east paved yard; estimated ~25 visible, capacity ~80.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a smaller attached/adjacent office structure on the east side.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Omaha metro's Sarpy West industrial submarket, surrounded by other large warehouses and suburban development — Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property visible.
